summary: User shows up as "Unknown" when holding ID card in hand and trying to do something

comments.content: What steps will reproduce the problem? 1. Move ID from wear_id to a hand 2. Try to lock/unlock a secure closet. What is the expected output? What do you see instead? Should see: "The locker has been locked by <name>." Actually see: "The locker has been locked by Unknown." Patch soon with fix, in UpdateClothing look for ID cards in left/right hands, as well as the wear_id slot when updating mob.name

This patch appears to update code that now [/unstable] resides in:
/code/game/mob/carbon/equipment.dm
in the section:
/mob/carbon/proc/update_name()

But I think the code in question has been changed too much for the patch to apply,
and I don't really know what's going on. So I'll leave this alone for now. Hopefully
that info will help save someone time.
